# ANALYSIS: Base Engine Stage-1 Backtest Results

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** analysis  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We are running the Stage-1 backtest on the base engine (no changes) to compute edge_capture and wide_pnl on J anchor days and full history. This establishes the baseline performance against which all strategy candidates are measured per OP-16.

## Mechanism

We executed the autoresearch grinder harness on the base engine over the full history (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) using real OPRA fills. Computed:
- edge_capture = sum(engine_pnl_on_J_winners) - sum(max(0, engine_loss_on_J_losers))
- wide_pnl = total P&L over the full history
- Additional metrics: aggregate Sharpe, max drawdown, quarterly consistency, concentration.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Dual-account setup (Gamma-Safe: $2K equity, 30% risk/trade; Gamma-Bold: $1.65K equity, 50% risk/trade). Wide_pnl scales linearly with account size; $1K paper account realizes ~28% of headline wide_pnl.
2. **Sample bias:** Full history (18 months, 2025-01-02..2026-06-18) used; no selection bias. Overfit risk mitigated by OP-16 anchor focus and walk-forward gates in candidate evaluation.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (this Stage-1 backtest uses full history; OOS requires walk-forward held-out window per OP-22).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (per-day validation on top 3 J days not performed; requires realistic simulator comparison vs BS-sim).
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: -$1,210 (2025-08-12, volatile FOMC reaction)
   - Max drawdown: -$2,273 (peak-to-trough, 2025-10-02 to 2026-03-14)
   - Blow-up scenario: Consecutive 4-day losing streak > -$1,800 (occurred 2x in sample, recovered via position sizing)
6. **Concentration:** Top-5 days = 68% of wide_pnl (4/29, 5/01, 5/04, 1/03, 11/08). Top-10 days = 89%. Ordinary day median P&L = +$4.20.
